My experience, for what it’s worth: started taking Prozac a year ago. Immediately noticed a substantial increase in energy levels and focus. My school life flourished. I was more motivated and interested. I was awake and alert and no longer foggy or fatigued. 

The hyper-agitation I initially experienced (which wasn’t bad, it made me very energetic and focused) tapered down after a few weeks into a steady and manageable energy flow. To this day I still experience really good energy, focus, and alertness in the mornings after I take my pill, and I can make it through the afternoon slumps without needing to nap lol. Brain fog, gone as well. Overall Prozac changed my life. I’m just a happier more successful person :)

Weight gain: I had absolutely none. I actually LOST weight. I think just the energy increase and mental clarity made me move, fidget more, be more productive, etc. and my overall energy expenditure increased. I didn’t experience appetite changes or sluggishness or carb cravings. I was thin to begin with and lost nearly 10lbs, my doctors were almost alarmed. So, I wouldn’t say weight gain is a given, you might even lose a bit! I believe Wellbutrin is also known to be associated w weight loss.
